candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, rustfmt, clippy, opening-book tests, a native material-only USI smoke, and local WebAssembly package generation passed. Version 0.4.0 preserves the v0.3.73 sekirei-core public API and adds fail-closed publication checks for all seven workspace crates and the versioned WebAssembly asset. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.0.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The default material evaluator and search policy remain unchanged from v0.3.73.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
